fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting on Miami-area politics and civic affairs, including criticism of taxation levels and calls for government economy; discussion of labor conflict involving the Miami Herald and union solidarity; coverage of a Miami Beach divorce case involving Joseph E. Jacobson and allegations of fraud/perjury; commentary on employment agency practices and fees; reporting on Florida infant mortality and premature-baby care; criticism of access to medical care at Jackson Memorial Hospital; and civic/environmental concerns about dredge-and-fill development in Biscayne Bay. Also contains society/entertainment items, nightlife and theater advertising, and extensive local business advertisements and classifieds.
